Name: Simple Tab for 1.6
Author: Ruosour
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/6N4V4gn/simpletab.png[/img][/center]

[size=3][b]SimpleTab [/b]is an interface mod that replaces the standard tabs with a more minimalistic and varied one. With this mod, you can customize the appearance of the tabs and icons according to your preferences.
There are currently four tab styles: [color=#f6b26b][b]Classic[/b][/color], [color=#6fa8dc][b]Bookmark[/b][/color], [color=#93c47d][b]Bamboo[/b][/color],and [color=#76a5af][b]Bubbles[/b][/color]. Each style has its own unique design and color scheme that you can choose according to your needs.
[/size][u][size=3][center][i][For example, if you chose an island farm, the [/i][color=#b6d7a8][b]Bamboo[/b][/color][i][b] [/b]style would be just right.][/i][/center][i]

[/i][/size][/u][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/BLcFLkH/style.png[/img][u][size=3][i]

[/i][/size][/u]The mod also includes two styles for the icons: [b]Classic[/b], [b]Scout [/b]and [b]Simple[/b].﻿[u][size=3][i]
[/i][/size][/u][img]https://i.imgur.com/qaR3hGV.png[/img][/center]
[u][size=3][i]
[/i][/size][/u][size=3]﻿You can easily switch between the different styles of tabs and icons. This is very convenient, but requires an additional modification «‎[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]»[/size][size=3]

All in all, the [b]SimpleTab [/b]mod is a great way to diversify the faded look of the interface and transform it according to your needs and preferences.[/size]
